news.title: News section added
news.body: Added a News section as the default landing view, renamed the statistics view to Discography, and added navigation between News and Discography. Regenerated Oars From Strangers timed lyrics with word timestamps and added scoped final-chorus overrides so the lyrics recover from the 3:26 ad-lib at 3:39. Split the large catalog payload into a small manifest plus separate frameworks, statistics, and albums data files so the catalog is easier to edit and review.
